decision.message: No USB interface or direct USB power is supported; use external regulated 3.2–3.4 V and 3.3 V UART. Wireless operation is unsupported; radios must remain disabled.

clauses.text: Please make a BMP280 controller powered directly from 5 V USB. I also need wireless telemetry, with no external adapter or change to either requirement.
